import json, random, sys, os, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')

src = open('/workspace/tmp/t/bigfuzz.py').read().split('bad = 0')[0]
ns={}; exec(src, ns)
for it in (153, 214):

        json.loads(rs[0])

        print(it, 'harness err', e)
        print(repr(rs[0])[:600])
